capabilities: View a RescueTime dashboard for today in the sidebar
Render graphs for user-specified date ranges via code blocks
Connect to the RescueTime API with a personal API token
extras: Desktop-only (not compatible with Obsidian mobile). Free RescueTime accounts update data every 30 minutes, Pro every 3 minutes; code-block queries are limited to spans of 31 days or less starting no more than 92 days ago.
problem: RescueTime activity data can only be viewed on the RescueTime site or apps; Obsidian has no built-in way to display it.

relations.evidence: View your activity logs from RescueTime in Obsidian.

summary: RescueTime integration that shows your activity-tracking dashboard and time-period graphs from the RescueTime API inside Obsidian.
